page.title: Industry research
page.subtitle: Industry facts are aggregated from members' primary filings (aggregate method); every number opens its source drawer and replays from its manifest.
page.scopeSic: Disclosed company facts aggregated to industries by SEC SIC code. Aggregates and coverage only; no industry judgments.
page.scopeSw: Disclosed company facts aggregated to industries by SW 2021 classification. Aggregates and coverage only; no industry judgments.

stale.title: Stale data
stale.body: Expected weekly; past the 2-day grace. The page keeps showing the latest active run (facts as of {date}); that run was activated {activatedAt} (generation {generation}). Each cell's drawer names the run time.

error.title: Read failed
error.body: Showing the last good response ({at} UTC). Missing values are never shown as 0.
error.bodyNoCache: Nothing to show yet; try again shortly. Missing values are never shown as 0.

unlicensed.title: {scheme} data licence pending
unlicensed.body: Classification and membership data are SWS Research data relayed by Tushare; no number is shown until the display terms are confirmed. You can switch to the SIC scheme (US, public SEC data).

adminPreview.title: Internal preview
adminPreview.body: Dataset {dataset} is not public: only admins see these numbers; everyone else sees the licence-pending state.

empty.title: No active run yet
empty.body: No active aggregate run is available. Browse available classifications and constituents below; the heatmap appears once the first run completes. Aggregates are L1 only: L2 and L3 offer navigation and constituents.

reconstruction.title: Reconstruction: these cells are not what was visible at the time
reconstruction.bodySw: Historical periods are rebuilt from membership evidence obtained later: SW membership availability is assumed at the inclusion date (the source has no announcement time) and issuers are resolved by today's ownership. Compare trends, but do not read them as what investors saw then. Each cell becomes available at the run's activation, never back-dated to its period.
reconstruction.bodySic: SEC publishes only each company's current SIC code, with no history. Past periods are back-filled using today's SIC assignment, valid from the first observed date. Compare trends, but do not read them as what investors saw then. Each cell becomes available at the run's activation, never back-dated to its period. Constituent snapshot date: {date}.

partialUnpublished.title: Some dates not published
partialUnpublished.body: Only dates that pass the daily comparison are published; the series breaks at unpublished dates and percentiles use published dates only.

replayMismatch.title: Replay mismatch
replayMismatch.body: The manifest recomputes to a different value than the stored one. The cell is not treated as replayable: the page keeps the stored value with an anomaly badge, and a quarantine item (manifest self-check failed) is open.

officialUnavailable.title: Official comparison value unavailable
officialUnavailable.body: While the official dataset is not public, only the comparison status is shown, never the official value.

notEnabled.title: Valuation not enabled
notEnabled.body: Self-computed valuations are computed and published only after two basis checks are complete (SW PE/PB basis, total-share basis). Until then no self-computed valuation is shown, and official values are never shown in its place.

noJudgment.title: No judgment registered
noJudgment.body: Lifecycle stage, prosperity and over/under-valuation are judgments, not facts. They appear here only once registered in F4 with a falsifiable condition that can be settled; uncalibrated ones show only their category and a badge.

currentOnly.title: Current only
currentOnly.body: SEC publishes only the current SIC, with no inclusion or exclusion history: the in-date column is the first observation date and dates before it have no members.

noMembers.title: No known members on this date
noMembers.body: No member is valid on {on} by the evidence known today.

notPublished.title: Not published yet
notPublished.body: Self-computed valuations are calculated and published only after the basis reconciliation is complete. Until then no self-computed valuation is shown and no other source is substituted. Percentiles are not enabled.

withheldCn.title: China industry data: licence pending
withheldCn.body: This data comes from a commercial data service. Until its display terms are confirmed no number, list or chart is shown. US industries (SIC, public SEC data) are available.

adminPreviewVendor.title: Admins only · vendor data is not yet licensed for display
adminPreviewVendor.body: Dataset "{dataset}" has licence status "internal". Only admins see these numbers; other signed-in users see "data licence pending" and are pointed to the SIC scheme. Before it goes public the owner records the contract clause in the licence table.

notServed.title: Not served
notServed.body: No valuation is shown and no other source stands in for it.

missing.financial_excluded: Excluded by method: no gross margin for financials
missing.absent: Row missing from the expected grid

roles.dual_currency: reports in another currency; USD figure in the filing is a translation, not used

heatmap.label: Heatmap
heatmap.caption: Click a cell for its source drawer; click a name for the industry detail. One brass hue: shade means level, not up or down.
heatmap.mobileNote: Narrow screens show the last 3 periods; see the table for the full series.

table.label: Table view
table.yoyNotStored: No stored YoY for this metric
table.note: YoY shows only the stored YoY metrics (revenue, net income), signed, never red/green: an industry level is not a price move. Coverage = n_with_data / (n_members + n_unresolved); below 0.8 the value cell shows the coverage instead.

judgments.title: Judgments
judgments.scope: Scope: {scheme} · {level}. No judgment is registered for this scope.

detail.notAggregated: v1 aggregates SW level 1 only; this node offers navigation and constituents.
detail.chartLabel: {industry} {metric} series line; values in the table beside it
detail.chartCaption: Any point opens the source drawer (same as the table). Gaps are missing cells, not zeros.
detail.schemeSourceSw: SWS Research, Shenwan Industry Classification Standard (2021), adapted via Tushare index_classify / index_member_all
detail.schemeSourceSic: Current SIC in SEC submissions and the SEC SIC code list
detail.availabilitySw: Members are assumed available on their inclusion date (the source has no announcement time); issuers are resolved by today's ownership
detail.availabilitySic: SIC has current values only; valid_from = first observation date
detail.namesNote: SW publishes no English names: the English UI shows the Chinese name plus the code, without machine translation.

constituents.title: {name} · Constituents
constituents.rule: Date-driven: included on or before the as-of date and not yet excluded, by the evidence known today
constituents.name: Name
constituents.noFact: No published annual fact on this date
constituents.unit: Amounts: CNY in 1e8, USD in billions (raw values in the drawer) · page {page} / {pages}, {size} per page

drawer.title: Source drawer
drawer.reproducedNote: replayFromManifest() recomputes {value} from the manifest alone, equal to the stored value.
drawer.mismatchNote: The manifest recomputes to {replayed}; the stored value is {stored}.
drawer.recomputeMatch: match: a recompute on current evidence equals the recorded manifest.
drawer.recomputeChanged: changed: current evidence differs from the recorded manifest. Late filings, quarantine decisions, mapping upgrades and membership corrections all do this; it is expected.
drawer.diffCounts: members +{ma}/−{mr} ~{mm} · unresolved +{ua}/−{ur} · facts +{fa}/−{fr} · state revisions changed {revs}
drawer.missingCell: A missing cell has no manifest: {reason}
drawer.valuationReplayDeferred: Valuation manifest replay arrives with the valuation pipeline (I-3).
drawer.factEvidence: View the raw fact by fact_id
drawer.licenceNote: Access is controlled by the dataset licence.
drawer.attribution: Company disclosures and industry classification sources.

entry.title: Industry research
entry.desc: Choose a market and classification to browse industries and member companies.
entry.sicDesc: Current SEC industry classifications and member companies. Industry aggregates and valuations are not available.
entry.swDesc: Shenwan industry classifications and member companies, subject to data access.

stock.label: Industry
stock.currentOnlyHint: SEC provides only the current SIC code; no membership history

formulas.roe: Σ ttm_net_income_parent / Σ avg(equity_parent the day before the window, at period end)
formulas.net_margin: Σ net income attributable to parent / Σ revenue

formulasSic.net_income_parent_sum: Σ net income attributable to parent
formulasSic.net_margin: Σ net income attributable to parent / Σ revenue

cnList.detailScope: A Shenwan 2021 level-1 industry. The Chinese name comes from the classification source; the English name comes from a reviewed table in the repository, not machine translation at run time.
cnList.membersScope: Membership is a fact, but its history only starts at the first observation.
cnList.reconstruction: The vendor publishes neither its aggregation method nor the member list, so past values are not what was visible at the time. Each cell became available at this run’s activation, not at the period end.
cnList.judgmentBody: No registered judgment exists for this scope. Facts are shown as usual.
cnList.caption: Brass = positive, grey with a hairline frame = negative; the sign is always printed, depth shows magnitude only, not good or bad, and is not the market up/down colour. A cell opens its source; a row name opens the industry.
cnList.empty: The first sync of China industry data has not completed, so there is nothing to show. The grid appears once the first run is activated.

cnDrawer.templateNote: Not supplied by the vendor; the query template is recorded instead
cnDrawer.templateUnavailable: Not supplied by the vendor; no query template was recorded for this observation
cnDrawer.terms: The personal-account terms do not allow giving data to third parties.
cnDrawer.missingRule: Both periods must have values and the prior-year value must be positive. An absent prior period, missing input, or zero or negative denominator carries its own missing reason. A figure with no row in this run is marked “not in this run”.
cnDrawer.setChanged: Member counts differ between the two periods; the member set changed.
cnDrawer.inputsNote: Each input opens its own vendor-observation drawer. Licence follows the inputs (internal).
cnDrawer.replayNote: Replay re-parses the archived raw response; it never calls the vendor again.
cnDrawer.noReplay: This observation has no value to replay.
cnDrawer.replayFailed: Replay is unavailable for this run.

cnDetail.latestNote: Each number opens its source. We derive revenue YoY from the vendor’s cumulative figures.
cnDetail.chartCaption: A break is a missing value. Nothing is interpolated. The dashed line marks zero.
cnDetail.valuationBody: Valuation is not provided for this industry. No valuation is shown and no other source stands in for it.
cnDetail.prosperityBody: Prosperity dimensions and historical percentiles are not provided for this industry.
cnDetail.noJudgment: No judgment for this industry. No method is registered for this scope. Facts are shown as usual.
cnDetail.previewNote: The vendor returns no weights, so a top ten by weight cannot be shown. The first five by code are listed.

cnConstituents.currentOnly: The vendor returns the current list only. Entry and exit dating is not available yet. Snapshot fetched on {date}.
cnConstituents.noRows: No constituents are listed for this industry in this snapshot.
cnConstituents.emptyBody: The membership sync has not completed its first run. Constituents will be listed here afterwards.
